editorial:
Ever felt like your boss is driving you crazy and you just want to walk out of your job forever? You will totally relate to the three coworkers in this flick. They are tired of being treated like garbage, so they decide to do something wild: blow up their entire office. The vibe is a mix of dark humor and high tension. It starts off as a simple revenge plot, but as soon as they set the dynamite, things go sideways in the funniest way possible. You get to watch these regular people panic as their perfect plan turns into a complete mess.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the actors and the way the plot twists keep you guessing. The pacing is quick, so you never get bored, though some of the dialogue feels a bit over the top at times. If you love comedies where everything that can go wrong does go wrong, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the chaos, or just rent it on Apple TV for a movie night with friends. It is a great pick for a lazy weekend.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge twist when the characters realize they cannot actually leave the building because of a security lockdown. Just as they think they are trapped with the bombs, they discover that their boss was actually planning his own crazy scheme at the same time. In the end, the office does not blow up the way they planned, but the chaos leads to them finally getting the freedom they wanted from their toxic jobs.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and stories about hating your job.
